title: Steam disclosure
author: Pix4Geeks
selftext:
Hi there,

I was wondering about the Steam disclosure on AI. If I understood correctly, devs must disclose if they used gen-AI for any assets in the game, correct ?

If so, should we consider 3D models generated on Blender via MCP or script a gen-AI asset ?

  
EDIT/TLDR : yes

replies.author: Pix4Geeks
replies.body: Because I don't consider it generated the same way as 2D art. Technically, the LLM produces a code that is interpreted by Blender. This could be considered as part of the vibe-coding process, which don't need disclosure ;)

replies.author: Aggressive_Tie_3014
replies.body:
The 2D images are generated by code as well.

Adding an extra AI step between the AI and the graphic doesn't suddenly make it not AI.

replies.author: Pix4Geeks
replies.body:
I don't say it's not AI, it is definitely :) Just wondering on the Steam disclosure. 

But got 3 (same) answers already. I got it :)

replies.author: Free-Version-2746
replies.body:
Do you copy that code or the content created by Ai to your game? Yes. Need disclosed 

Content gen by code inside your game? That is Live-Generated Content. Need disclosed.

comments.author: meowyih
comments.body: Yes, and you can ask AI for such simple question. For your reference, the answer from AI is still yes.

replies.author: Pix4Geeks
replies.body: Thanks, human advice is also good some times :D

comments.author: AxiosXiphos
comments.body:
The a.i. disclosure is completely unenforced by steam, it's laughable.

But I recommend adding it just to save yourself the trouble.

replies.author: Pix4Geeks
replies.body: Yes, but I think 3D model are less recognizable than some generated images :) Or maybe it's just because I'm not used too.

comments.body: im just going to say im an evil task master forcing the clankers to do the work. They also can't get it right so i had to go in and hand fix thing.  That is going to be my disclosure.

comments.author: Livid_Shallot5701
comments.body:
forget it, all of you. 

you have to disclose ***Text and localization*** too. And since its majorly beneficial to localize the game in 10 different languages, much more than an AI disclosure would harm you, next to the fact that you are then no longer dishonest since i bet that all of you have some form of text written by ai, and if its just  Options-menu. 

so just be honest guys and 2027 when there will be 4000 ai games released, noone will care anyway anymore

comments.author: zenmatrix83
comments.body:
its what a certain set of people want, like conflict free diamonds and sustainable source materials. most people don't care, but one slip, and you'll get hammered. Its not worth hiding it, and you shouldn't be assaimed

  
mcp controlled blender is a tough one with an llm driving but its not a gen ai model. peoples main concern with generate ai models was the mass training online of al art. the vision models in claude use the same but differently, so it is likely the same.
